fields.description: Three tile natural wonder. Provides +5 Science to adjacent tiles. Units that enter it are teleported to an ocean far away, but naval units that do so earn the ability 'Mysterious Currents' (+1 Movement).

fields.description: Two tile natural wonder. It appears with Cliffs adjacent to water and provides +3 Culture, +2 Food, and +3 Gold. Provides +4 appeal, instead of the standard +2 appeal of Natural Wonders, to adjacent tiles. Improvements cannot be placed on it.

name: Desert Floodplains
summary: +2 Food. This low-lying area adjacent to a River has flooded before, giving it more Food production than a usual Desert tile.

fields.description: This low-lying area adjacent to a River has flooded before, giving it more Food production than a usual Desert tile. If the River floods again structures built on this tile may be damaged or destroyed, but the tile is also likely to gain additional yields.

name: Grassland Floodplains
summary: no yield change. This low-lying area adjacent to a River has not yet flooded so it starts the game with the same yields as a flat Grasslands tile.

fields.description: This low-lying area adjacent to a River has not yet flooded so it starts the game with the same yields as a flat Grasslands tile. If the River floods again structures built on this tile may be damaged or destroyed, but the tile is also likely to gain additional yields.

name: Geothermal Fissure
summary: +1 Science. The ground in this area, probably located near a boundary between two continents, has been ruptured by subterranean geothermal activity.

fields.description: The ground in this area, probably located near a boundary between two continents, has been ruptured by subterranean geothermal activity. Heated water and steam escape from the ground here, making it ideal to place structures such as Aqueducts, Roman Baths, and Hungarian Thermal Baths nearby.

name: Volcanic Soil
summary: no yield change. This land adjacent to a volcano has suffered from a previous eruption.

fields.description: This land adjacent to a volcano has suffered from a previous eruption. Although people and structures may have been damaged, the rich deposits of minerals the volcano has brought forth have probably enhanced the yields here. Rebuilding in this area may therefore be worthwhile, especially if the volcano goes dormant.

name: Volcano
summary: no yield change. This mountain tile, probably located near a boundary between two continents, starts the game as an inactive volcanic site but may become active as the game prog…

fields.description: This mountain tile, probably located near a boundary between two continents, starts the game as an inactive volcanic site but may become active as the game progresses. Once active, beware -- an eruption could occur at any time. Volcanic eruptions damage features and structures in adjacent tiles but may also leave behind volcanic soil that boosts the yields from that location.
